clinics.name: Medical Park Hospitals Group (MLP Care)
clinics.district: Istanbul (Kadıköy, Göztepe campus) plus 12 other Turkish cities
clinics.namedDoctors: Not named on the group's international pages read in October 2026 (medicalpark.com.tr blocked automated reading; mlpcare.com pages name no physicians).
clinics.credentials: On the Ministry of Health authorized-facility list (October 2026) as 'Özel Medicalpark Göztepe Hastanesi' (Kadıköy, Istanbul), 'Özel Medicalpark Bahçelievler Hastanesi', 'Özel Medicalpark Antalya Hastane Kompleksi' and 16 further Medicalpark / VM Medicalpark hospital entries. Parent company MLP Care states on its site that the group operates 38 hospitals with more than 7,000 beds under the Medical Park and Liv Hospital brands, founded 1993 in Sultangazi, Istanbul, and that it went public in 2017. The hospital-network page lists 24 Medical Park / VM Medical Park sites. MLP Care's history page states Medical Park Göztepe and Bahçelievler earned JCI accreditation in 2007; JCI claimed on clinic site; JCI directory not reachable (jointcommission.org returned 403 to automated reading, October 2026). The medicalpark.com.tr site blocked automated reading, so facts come from mlpcare.com and search snippets.
clinics.cautions: In November 2022 the Health Ministry suspended operations of Medical Park Tokat for seven days after relatives filmed two intensive-care nurses mistreating a paralysed patient; the Health Professions Board barred one nurse from the profession for three years and ordered retraining for both (Cumhuriyet, 23 November 2022, medicalpark-press-cumhuriyet). The group's hospitals are run by one listed company, not franchised.

booking.channels: MLP Care head office phone +90 212 227 55 55 (Flatofis, Haliç Otakçılar Cad. No:78, Eyüp, Istanbul); international-patient pages on medicalpark.com.tr/en could not be read by automated tools in October 2026. No WhatsApp or email was found on readable pages.

clinics.namedDoctors: The international site names Prof. Yılören Tanıdır (urology, Medicana Ataşehir), Prof. Cafer Adigüzel (hematology and bone marrow transplant, Medicana Ataşehir) and Serkan Selvi, M.D. (internal medicine, Medicana Ataköy). No society certifications stated; anesthesiologists not named.
clinics.credentials: On the Ministry of Health authorized-facility list (October 2026) as 'Özel Medicana İnternetional İstanbul Hastanesi' (Beylikdüzü, Istanbul; the list misspells International), 'Özel Medicana Ataşehir Hastanesi', 'Özel Medicana Ataköy Hastanesi', 'Özel Medicana Zincirlikuyu Hastanesi', 'Özel Medicana International Ankara Hastanesi', 'Özel Medicana International İzmir Hastanesi' and 10 further Medicana entries. The group's corporate page states 16 hospitals (the homepage says 19+), with activity since 1992. Its quality-policy page states JCI accreditation for Medicana International Istanbul (2010, re-accredited 2013 and 2016), Medicana Bahçelievler (2008, 2011), Medicana International Ankara (2010) and Medicana Çamlıca (2007, 2010), plus AACI accreditation for Ataşehir (2022) and International Istanbul (2023); JCI claimed on clinic site; JCI directory not reachable (jointcommission.org returned 403 to automated reading, October 2026).
clinics.cautions: In June 2022 bianet reported that a 71-year-old COPD patient died in the intensive care unit of Medicana International İzmir and that the family learned of the death a day later when they visited; the family filed a CİMER complaint. An İzmir criminal judgeship of peace then blocked access to 17 news items about the death at the hospital's request; the block was later lifted after a Constitutional Court ruling (bianet, medicana-press-bianet, medicana-press-bianet-censor).

booking.channels: Phone +90 850 460 1010 (Turkey) and +44 1962 587821 (UK office); WhatsApp +1 518 255 8924; contact form https://www.medicanainternational.com/en/contact-us; 'Let Us Call You' and Medical Second Opinion forms. Email shown on the site is obfuscated.

booking.languages: Website in English, Arabic, Russian, Macedonian, Albanian, Georgian, German, Bosnian, French, Romanian and Turkish; staff languages not stated.
